body.x: Camelotech, Inc. (CEO Jung Woncheol) participated in the global media event CES Unveiled, held on January 5th (local time) ahead of the official opening of CES 2025.

Camelotech, founded in 2020, is a green bio and digital healthcare startup. The company operates an integrated pharmacy franchise and provides automated pharmaceutical systems to traditional Korean medicine institutions. The system innovatively standardizes raw herbal extracts into 99.9% pure, 0.1g tablets without chemical additives through extraction and freeze-drying processes. This innovation has been highly recognized.

Camelotech has transformed the Korean herbal medicine prescription system by developing exclusive automated pharmaceutical equipment that uses standardized tablet-form materials (for both medicine and food) and a proprietary EMR program. This reduces the minimum manufacturing quantity from 60 packs to one pack, significantly shortening production time.

At CES 2025 and CES Unveiled, Camelotech showcased its automated pharmaceutical system, Cameleon. Based on prescriptions from Korean medicine practitioners, this system can produce three forms of herbal medicine—liquid, gel, and tablet. It is designed to enhance efficiency and convenience throughout the pharmaceutical process.

Cameleon incorporates an AI model trained with high-quality prescription data collected over seven years from 12 university hospitals and South Korea’s Ministry of Food and Drug Safety. This extensive learning enables milligram-level precision in manufacturing and supports accurate prescriptions through an AI-assisted EMR chart.

body.cap: Camelotech demonstrates its data-driven Korean herbal medicine automation system 'Cameleon' at CES 2025 Unveiled. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: A Camelotech representative stated, "This technology enables trainee practitioners to prescribe at the level of specialists, supporting accurate and timely prescriptions for optimal patient outcomes. It adds proven evidence to Korean medicine, elevating public trust in the field."

Through CES 2025, Camelotech aims to promote Korea’s standardized raw materials and customized pharmaceutical technologies globally. The company also plans to expand into the North American market, offering high-quality, personalized medicines for underserved populations as a key differentiator.

The representative noted, "The U.S. has the world’s largest herbal medicine market, more than double the size of China’s rapidly growing market. Americans recognize herbal medicine as a health supplement and pharmaceutical, with insurance coverage available in some states. We expect our products and technology to appeal highly to this market."

Adding, "Initially, we plan to introduce Cameleon through established Korean medical associations in the U.S. and monitor market reactions to expand our influence. We are delighted by the significant interest shown by global media at CES Unveiled, which serves as a stepping stone toward realizing our goals."

body.cap: Camelotech introduces 'Cameleon' to international media at CES Unveiled. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: AVING News, which has covered CES for 20 consecutive years, continues to support the global ambitions of Korean SMEs and startups through various initiatives.

Before CES 2025, AVING hosted a series of Global Media Meetups featuring aspiring SMEs in Korea. The Meetups introduced Korean SMEs’ technologies, products, and services to media worldwide, expanding connections between the Korean industry and global media. Geekspin, Ubergizmo, Interesting Engineering, and Le Café du Geek participated in these meetups.
During CES 2025, AVING established the AVING Broadcasting Zone at The Venetian Hotel in Las Vegas, interviewing CES Innovation Award 2025 winners.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host a review conference with participating companies in Korea, offering them a platform to gain further recognition and enhance their corporate image.
